name: SP1 Stage 2 — RevisionDelta pattern for revision step

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-01 RevisionDelta schema contains only delta fields

steps.text: the RevisionDelta Pydantic model is defined
the model has a new_responsibilities field of type list
the model has a new_controlled_processes field of type list
the model has a new_coordination_links field of type list
the model has a modified_responsibilities field of type list
the model does not have a responsibilities field for the full structure

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-02 run_revision produces RevisionDelta from LLM

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with a new responsibility RESP-3
the revision is run
the revision LLM call uses RevisionDelta as the response format
a revised ControlStructure model is produced

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-03 new_responsibilities are merged into existing ControlStructure

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with new_responsibilities containing RESP-3
the revision is run
the final control structure contains RESP-1
the final control structure contains RESP-2
the final control structure contains RESP-3

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-04 modified_responsibilities replace existing ones by resp_id

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with modified_responsibilities containing RESP-1 with an updated description
the revision is run
the final control structure contains RESP-1 with the updated description
the final control structure contains RESP-2 unchanged

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-05 new_controlled_processes are merged into ControlStructure

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with new_controlled_processes containing CP-2
the revision is run
the final control structure contains CP-2

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-06 new_coordination_links are added to ControlStructure

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with new_coordination_links containing CL-1
the revision is run
the final control structure contains coordination link CL-1

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-07 revision_user.j2 contains per-finding add-or-dismiss directive

steps.text: the template revision_user.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "add the missing element(s) to the RevisionDelta"
the template text contains "dismiss it with a one-sentence justification in dismissed_gaps"
the template text contains "gap_type"

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-08 revision_system.j2 contains ID format rules with next-available numbers

steps.text: the template revision_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "ID format rules"
the template text contains the rule for <element_kind> using <id_format>

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-09 revision_system.j2 next-available-ID template variables are computed from existing structure

steps.text: a control structure with responsibilities RESP-1 and RESP-2 and coordination link CL-1
the revision system prompt is rendered
the rendered text contains the next available responsibility number 3
the rendered text contains the next available coordination link number 2

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-10 RevisionDelta merge validates the final ControlStructure

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with new_responsibilities containing RESP-3 with valid PM, CA, and FB elements
the revision is run
the final control structure passes foundation validation

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-11 strip_empty_responsibilities remains as safety net after revision delta merge

steps.text: an LLM that returns a RevisionDelta with a new_responsibility RESP-4 that has no PM parts, CAs, or FB channels
the revision is run
the resulting control structure does not contain RESP-4
a warning is logged about the stripped empty responsibility

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-12 RevisionDelta merge preserves existing responsibilities not in delta

steps.text: an LLM that returns an empty RevisionDelta with no new or modified elements
the revision is run
the final control structure contains RESP-1
the final control structure contains RESP-2
the final control structure responsibilities count is 2

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-13 revision_user.j2 checklist includes each gap with add-or-dismiss directive

steps.text: the template revision_user.j2 is loaded
CriticFindings with gaps of type missing_responsibility and missing_feedback are available
the template is rendered with the critic findings
the rendered text contains a numbered item for the missing_responsibility gap
the rendered text contains a numbered item for the missing_feedback gap
the rendered text contains "add the missing element(s) to the RevisionDelta"
the rendered text contains "dismiss it with a one-sentence justification in dismissed_gaps"

scenarios.name: RevisionDelta-14 revision_system.j2 preserves existing rules about solution neutrality and valid references

steps.text: the template revision_system.j2 is loaded
the template text contains "solution-neutrality"
the template text contains "ElementRef references must be valid"
the template text contains "feedback channel updates must reference a PM in the same responsibility"

background.text: the STPA system model revision module is importable
a control structure with responsibilities RESP-1 and RESP-2 is available
CriticFindings with unjustified gaps are available
a run directory for call logging
